case.summary: Online transaction 3567717 for $99.93 on card C05674-K1 was flagged via model monitoring due to a score of 0.992 (92.1% calibrated historical fraud rate) against a dormant legacy score. The purchase occurred under a new holder profile in region 299 using device D004839 behind a transparent IP proxy. Graph analysis linked device D004839 to multiple active fraud rings and compromised cards, including C00750-K2, C07212-K2, and C06224-K2 during December 2016, showing a 7.33 fraud lift over baseline. Based on conclusive evidence of shared syndicate infrastructure and unauthorized card-not-present usage, the transaction was determined to be fraudulent. The card was blocked, connected cards were placed under monitoring, and a regulatory filing was initiated.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details suspected card-not-present fraud impacting customer C05674 on card C05674-K1. On December 23, 2016, at 01:44:18 UTC, an unauthorized online purchase of $99.93 (transaction ID 3567717) was conducted in billing region 299. The transaction was routed through an Apple iOS device (device ID D004839; iOS 11.3.0, mobile safari 11.0, resolution 2208x1242) utilizing a transparent IP proxy to obscure network routing. Internal monitoring flagged the activity when the bank's second-generation fraud model scored the transaction at 0.992, reflecting a calibrated historical fraud rate of 92.1 percent. The cardholder had no prior transaction baseline in billing region 299 or on this device identity. Subsequent graph analysis revealed that device D004839 is shared infrastructure directly linked to multiple active fraud rings during December 2016. Specifically, the device was utilized across cards C00750-K2 (ring 57671727), C07212-K2 (ring 34603052), and C06224-K2 (ring 37749036) as a new device behind proxies. In total, device D004839 was involved in 23 elevated-risk transactions across 18 distinct cards in the monitoring period, generating a 7.33-fold lift over baseline fraud rates. Total unauthorized exposure on card C05674-K1 is $99.93. The bank has blocked card C05674-K1, initiated monitoring across connected cards, and is submitting this report due to coordinated unauthorized syndicate access.

stop_reason: The investigation was concluded under Policy Section 6 because the fraud probability reached 0.97, well exceeding the decisive 0.85 threshold with multiple independent incriminating bases—including high calibrated model risk, shared fraud ring device infrastructure, and masked proxy routing—such that further steps would not alter the decision.
